full_sentence: It was raining, so we took an umbrella.

options.why_wrong: Going to the beach is not a logical result of rain, so this does not fit after 'so'.
This contradicts the stem, because it was raining. It is not a result of the rain.
This is an action, but it has no logical connection to the rain.

explanation: 'So' introduces a result, so the second part must be a logical consequence of the first part. Learners whose first language has a single connector for both cause and result often mix up 'so' and 'because', so check which meaning the sentence needs.
translation: Yağmur yağıyordu, bu yüzden şemsiye aldık.
